verification.summary: Both prior must-fix items are properly resolved, but accs.bash never tests the buffer-cap/truncation behavior that spec.md's whole 'GitHub Cli Revamp' breakpoint is about, letting a broken truncation implementation pass silently.

mustFix.problem: accs.bash forces the cap to 500 for the entire run so truncation never has a chance to trigger, and no step anywhere checks the default cap (min(tty,200)/200 fallback) or the '...' truncation line. Spec.md dedicates a full breakpoint to this and 'Done when' lists 'line count never exceeds the active cap' as a requirement, yet nothing in the script verifies it, so a broken truncation implementation still passes.

shouldFix.quote: accs.bash invokes spec 001's frozen accs.bash then this spec's own steps, neither exporting MOCK_GITHUB_PORT
shouldFix.problem: This Behaviour row claims accs.bash chains spec 001's frozen accs.bash, but the actual script never calls it - it starts pnpm mock-github directly. The doc and the implementation disagree, which will confuse whoever reads this spec next even though nothing here is strictly required by accs.md.

shouldKnow.quote: MAKE SURE THAT ONLY THE MOCK INSTANCES ARE BEING USED!
shouldKnow.problem: accs.bash never checks env vars to confirm no real GitHub token/URL is configured - it just trusts pnpm mock-github and pnpm issues-tracker point at the mock by default. Reasonable given the contract, but it's an assumed guarantee rather than a verified one.
